nom: Lancôme Génifique Ultimate Eye Cream with Beta Glucan-CM

avis.texte: I like this eye cream. I have sensitive skin and this doesn't bother my under eyes.
What can I say, othet than this is the best eye cream that i habd ever used. I absolutely love this stuff!!

And this is by FAR the best eye cream I've found. A little goes a long way. I apply to my under eye and around the "crows feet" area. Using regularly, once in the morning and once in the evening, I can definitely tell a difference. I don't have eye wrinkles and look younger than I am. Love this stuff.

Im 48 and my eye cream was discontinued. I tried fancy expensive eye creams, highly rated eye creams, you name it. They just werent working, so i started looking at ingredients and this one fot the bill. Ive gone through two jars now and i love it! My main concerns are small lines and wrinkles, puffiness in the morning, and dry under eyes. This takes care of them all.

Thus product is extremely pricey and doesn't live up to it's price point. For the price it should glide on like butter and my skin should sigh a sign if relief and say "oh thank you..." , like it does when i use my Kiehl's Eye Treatment, which is 2/3 of the price of Lancome. I saw and felt no visible difference whatsoever.
I was recommended by two friends and I am happy I took their advice. It works great on my 67 year old skin. It's my favorite and I will stick with it.

avis.titre: I would buy and use this product again.
avis.texte: The product seems to be the same as the previously made product. I've used this for a couple of years and have not had any issues with it drying my skin. I also use it twice a day in the morning and evening.

avis.titre: "Ultimate" seems to be exactly the same as the original
avis.texte: I've been a fan of Lancome's eye cream for a couple of years now. I was very concerned when I noticed the slight name change and was worried that the formula would be significantly different. I was fortunate to find a tester in my local Ulta and gave it a try. Seems exactly the same to me, which is perfect!
I actually love this product. Ive used many eye creams and this one, when after waking up, makes my old people eyelids look better 🤷🏽‍♀️

avis.titre: Zero stars, Worst eye cream ever, be careful!!!
avis.texte: I never write negative reviews, but I don't want this cream to harm anyone else's skin. My skin has never been sensitive and I have never had a reaction to any product. But this is horrible, I ordered it with high expectations but it was my mistake not to read the reviews before. Not only did it dry out my skin around my eyes, I also had a rash around my eyes and face, I had swelling in my eyes for a week and discharge. I only used it for two days giving it a chance but it was the worst thing I did. I had to go to the dermatologist. Please DO NOT buy this, stay away from this eye cream. Ulta was kind enough to give me a refund, but I'm still dealing with dry skin around my eyes after weeks.

Like the other review mentioned, this eye cream dried my skin underneath my eye out really bad. So bad, my skin was cracked, flakey and a little puffy due to the irritation. I never applied on my upper lid, just underneath lower lash line but not close to my lower lash line. I have never had any reaction to any skin products before. I switched from using a fragrance free eye cream to try this product, which does contain fragrance. So my guess is that the fragrance may be the irritant possibly. Bummed. Lancome has always been known for their great products, but this will not be a brand I purchase again.

I bought this as a birthday gift to myself this year and I will absolutely repurchase it when it runs out. I noticed a difference within a few days and the skin around my eyes has never looked better. I'm 39 years old and only have mild wrinkles/crow's feet and moderate dark circles. I don't need nearly as much concealer, my eyes look so much brighter and the skin is plump and healthy. The consistency is thick, a little goes a long way, and it sits beautifully under makeup. I think this will be a staple in my skincare routine for years to come.

I used this for two days and my eyes felt like I had sand in them. I would wake up with super crusty and very irritated eyes, I did not apply it too close to my eyelids. Avoid this if you have sensitive/dry eyes!!!
